name: myanmar-airport
notes:
Location of Airports in Myanmar. Attributes include Airport Name, Status , Lat, Long and Location by Administrative boundaries.
Data source: Mission Aviation Fellowship International (MAF International - Myanmar), https://www.mafc.org/countries/myanmar | September 2020
